spec.description: Status reports from the SPG data servers, which feed radar data to the Supplemental Product Generators at airport TDWR sites. JSON-LD: the reports come as a `@graph`.

request.title: ListSpgdsRequest
request.description: Which reports. Without `published`, the latest two from each server.

published.description: Only reports made in this ISO 8601 interval: `start/end`, `start/duration` or `duration/end`, either end may be `NOW`, such as `2026-09-30T12:00:00Z/PT1M`. The service keeps about a week; each server reports about every 15 seconds, so an hour is about 1,000 reports and 4 MB.

response.title: SpgdsCollection
response.description: The reports, as a JSON-LD graph.

@graph.description: The reports, newest first. Empty when nothing was published in the interval.

items.title: RadarSpgds
items.description: One status report from one SPG data server.

dataflow.title: SpgdsDataflow
dataflow.description: Whether data is flowing through the server.

state.description: State code: `1` on a healthy server. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

stateSince.description: When the state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

stateValid.description: When the state was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

state.description: State code: `1` on a healthy server. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

stateSince.description: When the state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

stateValid.description: When the state was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

appRunning.title: SpgdsApplication
appRunning.description: Whether the server application is running.

state.description: State code: `1` on a healthy server. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

stateSince.description: When the state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

stateValid.description: When the state was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

conns.description: Open LDM connections, sent as a string.

connsValid.description: When the count was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

state.description: State code: `1` on a healthy disk. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

stateSince.description: When the state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

stateValid.description: When the state was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

pctUsed.description: Disk used, in percent, sent as a string.

pctUsedValid.description: When the usage was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

spgdsUpSince.title: SpgdsUptime
spgdsUpSince.description: How long the server has been up.

upSince.description: When it came up, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

upSinceValid.description: When that was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

in.description: Inbound rate, sent as a decimal string. The unit is undocumented.

inDateTime.description: When the inbound rate was measured, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

inValid.description: When it was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

out.description: Outbound rate, sent as a decimal string. The unit is undocumented.

outDateTime.description: When the outbound rate was measured, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

outValid.description: When it was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

spg.description: Each Supplemental Product Generator the server feeds, by site identifier (`TATL`, `TBOS`): 46 per server on 2026-10-01.

additionalProperties.title: SpgSite
additionalProperties.description: The feeds to one SPG site.

swimDataState.description: State of the SWIM data feed: `1` up, `0` down. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

swimDataStateSince.description: When that state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

swimDataStateValid.description: When it was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

ldmPingState.description: Whether the site answers an LDM ping: `1` yes, `0` no. Undocumented, so not enumerated.

ldmPingStateSince.description: When that state began, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

ldmPingStateValid.description: When it was last confirmed, in Unix seconds sent as a string.

notes: Every time and count in a report except `timestamp` is a numeral string: Unix seconds (`"1787640004"`) or an integer or decimal (`"46"`, `"6491703.0"`). The schema declares each one's format so the clients parse them, rather than leaving the string.

The example records one minute, moved by `refresh_examples.py` to a minute about a day old, since the service keeps about a week of reports (a window on 2026-09-20 answered an empty `@graph` on 2026-10-01).
